I can't see account details, so I can't tell whether your last payment went through. You can check it yourself in the Lumen app under **Settings > Billing**, where your invoices are listed.

If you don't see the payment there, or something looks wrong, email **billing@lumen.io** and include:
- The email on your Lumen account (dana@corp.com, if that's the one you use)
- The date and amount of the payment you're asking about
- A short description, such as "I expected a charge on [date] but don't see it in Billing"

Please don't share card numbers or passwords in this chat.
